name: harbor
description: Design trustworthy agent evaluations and use Harbor's official task, Exec and publishing workflows.

interface.longDescription:
Build agent evaluations that answer a clear question. Design realistic cases, calibrate verifiers and interpret failures with explicit limits.

Includes six officially sourced Harbor workflows for tasks, Reward Kit, Exec, adapters, Hub publishing and parity uploads. Their names start with Official; this plugin is independently maintained.

Execution needs compatible installed tools, an isolated backend and agreed model settings. Publication and uploads require explicit review and authorization. Optional parity PR creation needs a separately installed Python dependency.
defaultPrompt: Design a focused Harbor evaluation for the agent behavior in this project.
Review this Harbor evaluation for weak verifiers and unsupported claims.
Use the official Harbor skills to plan a task, Exec job or reviewed publication.
